description: On the tabletop there are a couple of small Tolkien paperbacks, a red book off to the right, and an open slipcase/box standing at the back-right corner against the walls. The left hand stays low and relaxed near the center while the right hand picks up a small paperback, carries it up and to the right, turns it upright, and slides it into the slipcase; then the right hand brings another paperback over, aligns the spine, pushes it in beside the first book, and releases, leaving both books neatly inserted.
